fields.description: Single ID Proof: only one ID proof can be selected as the base of the Unique ID. Multi ID Proof: more than one ID proof can be allowed, combined into a single ID.
fields.label: ID Proof Selection Mode
fields.options:
Single ID Proof
Multi ID Proof

fields.description: Select every ID proof to combine into the Gig Worker's Unique ID. At least one must be selected.
fields.label: Unique ID Format Based On (select all that apply)

fields.description: Enter the starting running number, e.g. 001. Each new Gig Worker Unique ID generated will auto-increment this number (001, 002, 003 ...); leading zeros set the padding width.
fields.label: Suffix (Starting Running Number)
